Hi Ava / Ben,

Hope you’re both well. As we approach your renewal conversation, we wanted to combine a short QBR with a focused roadmap/demo covering features that map to your planned expansion (especially dedicated routing and autoscaling policies). Goal: align on usage patterns, identify two quick wins, and agree next steps for Dedicated capacity sizing.

Would one of these times work for a 60-minute session? I’ve suggested the window in PST and included conversions for your team:

- Wed Nov 3, 10:00–11:00 AM PST (UTC-8) — Thu Nov 4, 1:00–2:00 AM CET
- Thu Nov 4, 12:00–1:00 PM PST — Thu Nov 4, 9:00–10:00 PM CET
- Fri Nov 5, 8:30–9:30 AM PST — Fri Nov 5, 5:30–6:30 PM CET

If none of these work, tell me a few times that do and we’ll accommodate. Planned attendees on our side: myself, Marissa Cole (CSM), and Lauren Bishop (Solutions Engineer). If procurement or an exec will join, let us know and we’ll adjust the agenda.

I’ll circulate an agenda and the short slide deck once we lock the time.

Thanks,
Karthik

Thanks — this looks great. Quick heads-up: our CTO (based in Berlin) has a calendar freeze on Wed morning (UTC+1) so the Nov 3 slot is problematic for us. We’d prefer a late-evening CET slot or the Fri option. A few constraints:

- Max 45 minutes if the CTO or Director joins.
- Please include a short procurement slide (billing/commit tiers) and any security notes about VPC/private deploy options.

Our availability (CEST / CET):
- Thu Nov 4, 8:30 PM CET (works for Ben and me)
- Fri Nov 5, 5:30 PM CET (preferable if you can do the 60 min)

Can you confirm attendee list on your side and drop an agenda? Also looping procurement@bridgeview.io if we need contract-level details.

Cheers,
Ava

Please pick the slot that works best and indicate the format preference.

Proposed slots (in your timezone CET):
- Option A (exec brief, 45m): Thu Nov 4, 20:30–21:15 CET / 11:30–12:15 PDT (Nov 4)
- Option B (full demo, 60m): Fri Nov 5, 17:30–18:30 CET / 8:30–9:30 PDT (Nov 5)

Planned attendees: Karthik Iyer (AM), Marissa Cole (CSM), Lauren Bishop (SE). Lauren will demo the Dedicated capacity flow and autoscaling policies; Marissa will review usage trends and renewal checklist. We’ll include a one-slide procurement summary and a security appendix.

I’ve attached a brief agenda and the slides we’ll reference so you can share with your CTO. Attachments: BridgeView_QBR_agenda_v1.pdf, redwood-roadmap-slides.pptx

If Fri (Option B) works, we’ll block 60 minutes and circulate calendar invites with dial-in details. If you prefer Option A, we’ll send a shorter, executive-friendly invite.

Thanks,
Karthik
